thread:
Mika (oncall): :rotating_light: 08:10 UTC - sudden surge of 401s from hosted API (clients hitting /v1/chat/completions). ~1.2k 401s in last 5m. Error lines point to token introspection failures and `invalid_kid`. Last change: signing-key rollout job ran ~08:00 UTC. @Noah @Priya can you confirm?

Jared (sre): looking at infra metrics — auth-introspect latency spiked, a bunch of 5xx talking to jwks cache + redis timeouts. Also seeing TLS handshakes failing on a subset of identity nodes. digging into pod logs now.

Priya (eng-runtime): I don't control the KMS rollout job directly, but I can pause any runtime config that depends on the new keys. If this is a key propagation issue, we might need to revert the JWKS endpoint. What's the immediate impact on clients?

Noah (eng-identity): Confirmed: JWKS published at https://auth.prod.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json replaced with a new keyset at 07:58 UTC. Some auth caches (CDN + in-process caches) still serve the old JWKS; introspect service is returning 500 when the `kid` in token doesn't match current keyset. Looks like a propagation TTL mismatch between key-rotation job and CDN edge invalidation.

Sophie (support): Getting real-time threads from customers: a mid-size SaaS customer reported 401s starting ~08:07 UTC. They provided a curl repro: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```
Their server logs show `introspect: invalid_kid` and `introspect: 500`. They're asking for ETA.

deploy-bot: deploy auth-service v1.3.4 -> v1.4.0 @ 07:55 UTC by noah-deploy, key-rotate-job executed @ 07:58 UTC. Canary passed in 3/4 zones.

Mika (oncall): Proposal: pause/rollback key-rotation job and invalidate CDN cache for jwks.json, then restart introspect pods to pick up correct keyset. Can someone from eng-identity flip the flag? @Alyssa start drafting CS message.

Noah (eng-identity): Pausing key-rotate job now (k8s batch job suspended). Flipping feature flag `signing_key_rolling` -> `disabled` in config-store. Pushing hot-config. Will TTL-invalidate CDN after.

Priya (eng-runtime): Sending a rolling restart to introspect deployment (graceful) now to clear in-memory JWKS caches. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-introspect -n prod`

Jared (sre): I triggered CDN invalidation for `/.well-known/jwks.json` on all regions. Watch logs for retried JWKS fetch.

Noah (eng-identity): Paste from introspect log around failure: 
```
[name=introspect] 2026-03-15T08:07:12Z ERROR fetch_jwks: fetch failed status=200 body_checksum_mismatch kid=oldKID
[name=introspect] 2026-03-15T08:07:12Z ERROR token_verification: invalid_kid token=xxx user=acct_123
[name=introspect] 2026-03-15T08:07:13Z ERROR jwks_client: unexpected 500 when cache miss and remote returned inconsistent set
```
The `body_checksum_mismatch` suggests partial propagation where some edges served mixed versions.

Sophie (support): Customers want immediate mitigation. Can we provide guidance for them to retry + exponential backoff? Also request CS for affected customers to open support tickets for credits.

Alyssa (cs): Drafting message: "We're investigating an authentication regression impacting some API requests; if you're seeing 401s, please retry with exponential backoff. We're prioritizing affected customers and will follow up with credits where appropriate." Will share per-customer notes once we know scope. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Key-rotate-job suspended by noah-deploy @ 08:16 UTC. CDN invalidation request queued id=inv-8793.

Mika (oncall): What about an emergency short-lived signing key fallback? Could we accept both keysets for a minute to reduce failures?

Noah (eng-identity): Good idea — enabling dual-key acceptance in introspect config for a 15m window. Applying patch to config and restarting pods again. Patch diff: 
```diff
- accepted_kids = ["v2"]
+ accepted_kids = ["v2","v1"]
```
This should allow tokens signed with previous KID to verify. Rolling out now.

Jared (sre): After enabling dual acceptance and restarts, 401 rate dropped ~85% within 4 minutes. Still seeing a tail in one region (ap-southeast) where invalid edges were slow to flush.

Sophie (support): Noted reductions — customers reporting recovery. One customer asked about root cause and whether keys are compromised. Need a short statement: it appears to be a propagation/migration bug not a security event.

Noah (eng-identity): Confirmed no key leakage, keys rotated as planned — mismatch due to CDN caching + a race in the key-rollover script that updated a subset of origin servers before invalidation. Security: NO COMPROMISE.

Mika (oncall): Current status: 401s returned to baseline in most regions. ap-southeast still ~5% above baseline. Monitoring. Actions: (1) keep dual-key window open 15m, (2) audit key-rotate job to make it atomic, (3) postmortem + customer comms, (4) billing review for affected accounts.

billing-bot: Please open a billing case with tag `incident-2167890123` for any customer credit requests. Include impacted account list.

Alyssa (cs): Will collect impacted customers and open support tickets; will coordinate credits once we have the scope.

Jared (sre): Follow-ups for infra: add health-check that validates JWKS consistency across edges before rotating; add a canary flag that requires all edges to serve new JWKS before commit.

Priya (eng-runtime): On runtime side: make introspect tolerate transient JWKS mismatch with exponential retries to JWKS origin + backoff. Also add better log annotation to detect `body_checksum_mismatch`.

Noah (eng-identity): I'll own the postmortem and the key-rotation fix. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD tomorrow. Will include timeline, root cause (non-atomic CDN/invalidation + race in rollout), mitigations, and customer list.

Mika (oncall): Thanks team. Current metrics: 401 spike mitigated, 95th percentile auth latency back to normal, rolling out final cleanup. Closing thread when the ap-southeast tail is resolved. :white_check_mark:

Sophie (support): Marking impacted-support tickets with `incident-2167890123`. Customers updated.

Alyssa (cs): Sending initial comms to affected customers now. Will include assurance of no key compromise and next steps for credits.

deploy-bot: CDN invalidation inv-8793 completed @ 08:22 UTC.

Jared (sre): ap-southeast tail resolved @ 08:26 UTC — 401 rate normal. All mitigations in place.

Mika (oncall): Incident resolved. Postmortem owner: Noah (eng-identity). Action items assigned. Thanks everyone. :tada:
